owner: Original P6 106/423 source-owner dialogue; no duplicate canonical content owner
intent: One-pass triage of every node outside the twelve already researched Vatican documents. Attribution and source-genre routing, NOT original-text research completion.

sourceCharacterizationNotes: Salzano page is a later edition/transcription with embedded editorial commentary; text vs commentary must be isolated before any witnessed claim is admitted.
1905 catechism was prescribed by Pius X after adoption with minor revisions of a previously approved Italian episcopal text; papal sponsorship does not establish individual sentence authorship.
Quam singulari is a decree of the Sacred Congregation approved by Pius X, rather than a papal-authored encyclical.
No new research node is source-gated or released by this inventory.

references.use: 1905 Catechismo Maggiore edition and Pius X letter on adopted preexisting text
Quam singulari Congregational signatory and papal approval

PAPAL_DOCUMENTS.instruction: Collate original Vatican Latin/Italian passages and exact local propositions; mark quoted speakers; historical policies require period scope.

SALZANO_MANUSCRIPT.instruction: Separate transcribed manuscript questions and answers from later museum editorial commentary; preserve original orthography, manuscript adjustments and precise numbered locus.

CATECHISMO_MAGGIORE_1905.instruction: Audit 1905 printed edition and cited paragraph; do not present catechism passages as personally composed or spoken by the Pope.

BIOGRAPHICAL_SECONDARY.instruction: Verify person, dates, episode and biography source. Avoid invented thoughts, dialogue and spiritual recollections.

CONGREGATIONAL_DECREE.instruction: Separate Congregation's signed norms from papal approval. Do not use as autobiographical papal speech.
